subject: Orchard Labs — payee migration, PO ops handoff and remittance update
messages:
From: Katherine Park <katherine@orchardlabs.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Orchard Labs — upcoming bank migration / remittance + request to update vendor record

Hi Aditya —

Quick note from Orchard Labs finance: we are migrating our payout bank to a new provider and the new remittance instructions will be effective 2025-08-01. To avoid payment delays on our outstanding invoices, can you please update our vendor record with the attached bank details and confirm who owns the POs going forward?

Attachments: orchard_bank_details.pdf (pdf) — new ACH/beneficiary instructions, effective 2025-08-01

A couple of clarifications up front:
- Legal entity remains Orchard Labs, Inc. (same TAX ID) — W-9 attached on request.
- Remittance contact will move to payments@orchardlabs.com.
- We can sign any vendor change authorization needed; we have an authorized-signer doc ready.

We’d like confirmation by EOD 2025-07-24 so our August run isn’t affected. Thanks — appreciate your help coordinating.

— Katherine Park
Finance Operations
Orchard Labs
Katherine@orchardlabs.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Katherine Park <katherine@orchardlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orchard Labs — upcoming bank migration / remittance + request to update vendor record

Katherine — thanks for the heads up and the attachment. I’ve looped in Monica from AP to advise on exact evidence we need to process a payee bank change, and Marissa so she can take ownership of the PO handoff if you’d like that (she runs our vendor ops).

Monica: please confirm the minimal required documents and expected timeline for the change. Off the top of my head we’ll need a signed bank change authorization and either an updated W-9 or confirmation that the TAX ID is unchanged. If AP needs the bank details submitted via a secure portal, let us know and we’ll arrange.

Katherine — is moving the PO owner to Marissa OK on your side? If yes, please confirm so Marissa can update routing and contact for future orders.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Accounts — Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Katherine Park <katherine@orchardlabs.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 14:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Orchard Labs — upcoming bank migration / remittance + request to update vendor record

Aditya / Marissa / Katherine —

Thanks for looping me in. To change vendor bank details in our AP system we require the following (standard Redwood AP process):

1) Completed AP bank-change form (signed by vendor authorized signer) — I’ve attached our template for your convenience.
2) A copy of the vendor bank letter or voided check (or bank confirmation PDF) matching the new account on the form.
3) Signed authorization naming the individual who can approve payments (company letter or board resolution for larger accounts).
4) Updated W-9 if the legal name or TAX ID changed; if unchanged, a line in the bank-change form confirming same TAX ID is sufficient.
5) New remittance email to be added to vendor profile (payments@orchardlabs.com).

Operational notes:
- We perform an ACH micro-test for new accounts; plan for 5–7 business days processing after we receive complete docs.
- If you want the PO owner changed to Marissa Cole, we’ll reassign the internal routing and update the vendor contact in the PO metadata; that is administrative only and does not impact payment cadence.

Please reply with the completed form and supporting docs. I attached: ap_bank_change_template.xlsx (fillable).

— Monica Patel
Accounts Payable — Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com
Attachment: ap_bank_change_template.xlsx (xlsx)

Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 08:51:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Orchard Labs — upcoming bank migration / remittance + request to update vendor record

Monica / Aditya —

Thanks — attaching the completed docs as requested.

Attachments included:
- orchard_bank_details.pdf (bank letter + routing)
- orchard_signed_authorization.pdf (signed authorizing signer)
- orchard_updated_w9.pdf (W-9 confirming TAX ID unchanged)
- orchard_sample_invoice.pdf (shows PO number we expect to reference)

Confirming the remittance contact will be payments@orchardlabs.com and we are happy to have Marissa Cole be the PO owner going forward. Please proceed with your micro-test and let us know when it is scheduled so we can confirm receipt on our side.

The vendor remittance contact has been updated to payments@orchardlabs.com and the PO owner has been reassigned to Marissa Cole as requested.

Next steps / timeline:
- Micro-test debit credited back (if successful) — expected 1 business day after 2025-07-24.
- Full payments will go through following clearance; we expect the first payment to be in the 2025-08-01 batch if the micro-test validates.

References: HubSpot ticket HS-32419 has been updated with the final attachments and change log: https://hubspot.example.com/ticket/HS-32419
Drive folder with redlined docs: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link/orchard-payee-change

Please confirm you see the micro-test on 2025-07-24 and that funds clear; once confirmed we’ll mark the ticket closed. If anything changes on your side (e.g., additional PO numbers to alias), reply here and we’ll update routing.

— Ben Carter
